title: Apply to YC
description: Startup accelerator batches for founders (including bio/health). Rolling applications; best when you have a founding team and a clear problem thesis.

title: IndieBio application
description: Biology-focused startup program with funding and lab support. Aimed at scientist-founders translating research into companies.

title: I-Corps Teams / Hubs
description: Customer-discovery training for researchers commercializing science. Often a first structured step from lab idea → startup hypothesis.

title: Join a BioLabs site / community
description: Shared lab infrastructure and startup community for early biotech companies. NYC and other sites support scientist-founders needing bench space.

company: Breakout Ventures / Breakout Labs lineage programs
title: Breakthrough scientific startup programs (check current calls)
description: Science-focused venture programs periodically open applications for deep-tech and life-science founders. Confirm active calls on the site.

title: CDL program streams
description: Objectives-based mentoring program for massively scalable science/tech ventures, with health/bio-related streams depending on site/year.

title: Runway Startup Postdoc Program
description: NYC postdoc-to-startup pathway combining research commercialization support with venture creation (eligibility varies by call).

title: Small business research funding
description: Non-dilutive US government funding for early-stage health/biotech companies. Critical path for many scientist-founders before or alongside seed rounds.
